name: create_project
description: Create or name a local research project. Host administration only.

name: list_projects
description: List local projects. Host administration only.

name: list_documents
description: List project documents and processing status.

name: register_document
description: Host attachment registration only; processing starts explicitly inside a Pi session.

name: prepare_document_sources
description: Prepare source pages and coordinate-aware tables; this is not completed ingestion.

name: start_document_processing
description:
Host Pi tool bridge. runtime.review_existing_only=true with review_metrics and force=false
    verifies existing source SHA/index/extraction provenance and reviews definitions only,
    preserving historical parsing, values and dates. Missing sources fail without reingestion.
    Runtime credentials stay in memory.

name: begin_script_cleaning
description: Host starts or resumes a financial Python cleaning attempt; returns its schema and source inventory.

name: inspect_document_routing
description: Read samples and existing metadata to identify source kind, publisher, authors, date and subject. Read more source pages when insufficient.

name: set_document_profile
description: Save source-grounded profile: kind=financial_report|broker_research|industry_research|mixed|other; title; publisher; authors; published_at ISO date; evidence[{field:kind|publisher|authors|published_at,page,quote}]; entities[{name,kind:company|industry|product|region|other,aliases:[],identifiers:{exchange,ticker,lei,isin},evidence:[{page,quote}]}]. Entity evidence accepts one quote object or multiple pages for name/ticker; routing/errors provide identity_candidates. Unknown publisher/date=null, authors=[]; omit unknown IDs. broker_research means company research; industry_research means sector research. Names/IDs must occur in quotes. Changed profiles require revisiting affected records.

name: save_research_claims
description: 按页保存有原文引句的观点。entity 用已登记名称或 {name,kind,aliases?,identifiers?}，仅单一主体时可省略；新主体需 entity_evidence。默认作者归属，quoted 的 speaker/institution 必须见于引句。空页用 claims:[] 加 empty_reason。修复返回的局部错误并继续 pending 页，空输出不是提取完成。

name: get_research_ingestion_status
description: Read source, numeric-table and pending-page progress. Continue tables with process_documents and prose with save_research_claims. Completion is not semantic verification.

name: query_research_records
description: 查预测/观点，独立于正式披露。filters：record_type=observation|claim,data_kind,entity_id/entity,metric,period,publisher（观点机构）,report_publisher,document_id,scenario,quality,as_of,query,latest_per_series,include_history。metric 为精确 ID/列表；query 多词 OR，支持金融缩写，query_terms 给实际词汇；未命中不证明缺数据。as_of 排除未知署期。latest_per_series 保留同日冲突及不同口径/情景；include_history 是提取修订。next_offset 继续。

name: run_cleaning_script
description: 沙箱执行一批 Cleaner 脚本：读 /input/cleaning_source.json 和 cleaning_sdk.py，写 /output/cleaning_result.json；无主库访问。返回 run_id 和校验摘要，ready 后直接 commit_cleaning_result；有效表独立提交，失败表留原错误。未完成或需细节才 get_cleaning_result。script_refs=[run_id] 复用同项目 /input/cleaning_<run_id>.py/.json。

name: get_cleaning_result
description: Read results and local mapping errors as needed; not a submission prerequisite. details=true includes original data and full mappings; table_indices selects tables, offset follows table_order.

name: commit_cleaning_result
description: 提交脚本全部表或 table_indices 选表。宿主读取原格值；修复返回错误并继续剩余表。reviews 只记录实际语义判断，省略不表示语义已核验。

name: get_processing_status
description: Get session-owned document processing progress, coverage and committed fact count.

name: cancel_processing
description: Stop this processing invocation only; shared work owned by other sessions continues.

name: get_data_catalog
description: Discover documents, locations, dynamic metric IDs and dimensions. query terms match OR; statement filters. Follow pagination.next_offset; dimensions describe this page only.

name: get_processing_checkpoint
description: Read persisted progress and remaining coordinates. Continue via process_documents(force=false); inspect specific issues with get_normalization_details.

name: get_document_index
description: 读页/表导航，section 可选，两节按各自 next_offset 继续。page_start/end 为含端点物理页；query 多词 AND 只查导航，正文用 search_evidence。include_preview 带预览，原文用页/表工具。

name: query_financial_data
description: Query exact disclosures and sources. filters: company/companies,metric/metrics,period/periods,year/years,scope/scopes,currency/currencies,statement/statements,document_id/document_ids,quality/qualities,version/restatement,dimensions. Discover metric IDs in the catalog; paginate limit/offset/total. Issues affect related calculations only.

name: get_asset_catalog
description: Host asset dashboard: project-scoped companies/industries, disclosures, forecasts, claims and source coverage. Read-only; no model calls.

name: get_dashboard
description: Host dashboard data: documents, canonical facts and classified metric catalog.

name: get_normalization_details
description: 读清洗映射及疑点，table_id 选表，review_only=true 选未决项，query 筛选。按 next_offset/total 继续；处理状态不是核验结论。

name: ingest_document
description: Historical rule-based ingestion baseline only; v0.3 uploads use register_document and Pi process_documents.

name: get_ingestion_status
description: Poll document parsing: queued/parsing/validating/ready/needs_review/failed/cancelled.

name: cancel_ingestion
description: Request cancellation of an ingestion job belonging to the project.

name: get_document
description: Read document metadata, source locations and quality summary.

name: get_source_page
description: Read a physical page and its image; page numbers start at 1.

name: get_source_table
description: List or read source tables with original cells, formulas and coordinates.

name: search_evidence
description: Search source evidence. filters: document_ids,entity_id,publisher (publishing institution),as_of,data_kind,document_kind; company matches subjects and issuer. as_of excludes unknown dates. Query structured records for exact numbers; follow next_offset.

name: get_financial_metrics
description: Read exact facts by dynamic metric ID, verified alias or Chinese label. Missing stays unknown; resolve conflicts locally.

name: financial_workpaper
description: 生成可绑定底稿及 CSV/Markdown。statement_analysis 含扣非与非经常损益、间接法补充资料桥、季度和 ROE；comparison 用同一报告本期/比较列生成跨期共同比、增长与杜邦，无需上一份报告；report_audit 检查研报算术与跨页差异。返回引用目录、发现与缺项。

name: calculate_financial_metrics
description: Decimal calculations: yoy(current,previous); ratio/margin/cash_conversion/debt_ratio(numerator,denominator); add/subtract/multiply/divide(a,b); sum(values). Values accept {fact_id}/{record_id}. yoy/percentage_change/margin/debt_ratio return %, ratio/cash_conversion return ratios. Use run_analysis for other formulas.

name: configure_processing
description: Host configuration only. Secrets are kept in memory, never returned or persisted.

name: index_embeddings
description: Index missing project evidence using explicitly configured Embedding API. May incur API charges.

name: get_app_state
description: Host only. Read persisted conversations/runs JSON.

name: put_app_state
description: Host only. Write persisted conversations/runs JSON via database owner.

name: list_app_state
description: Host only. List persisted conversations/runs JSON for this project.

name: run_analysis
description:
隔离执行 Python 或声明式 report，产物写 /output。/input 的 pages.json、tables.json、facts.json、research_records.json 为项目资料；预测不等于披露。
示例 report={tables:{t:{columns:{v:{unit:'亿元'}},rows:[{v:{record_id:'ID'}}]}},body:'{{table:t}}'}，可省 code。单元支持 fact_id/record_id 或 {value,unit,currency,source}。自写脚本可输出 /output/analysis_report.json，或用 analysis_report.save_table 导出带类型 CSV。完整接口见 /input/analysis_report.md；自由 Python/Matplotlib 及布局保留。
参数更新用 source_run_id+params={NAME:值|{'+':增量}|{'*':倍率}}，params_order 指定贡献顺序；修复用 edits=[{before,after,replace_all?}]，省 code/edits 复用脚本。完成后给出版本引用与首选对比表。无网络、凭据或主库访问。 聊天回答可直接用 {{表名.行键.列名}} 或 {{table:表名}}，图片用 {{chart:文件名}}；完整产物用 get_artifact 读取。状态给出 available_params。
Finance: 金融版 model_refs={base:{artifact_id,revision_id}} 挂载 /input/models.json，复用 base.result；report 单元可填 {model:"base",path:"results.value_per_share"}。comparisons={change:{baseline:"base",scenario:"scenario",order:[路径]}} 导出差异。finance_charts 提供 record_values/model_values 换单位、waterfall、comparison_heatmaps；自由绘图仍可用。

name: get_analysis_status
description: 读取运行状态、精确表、显示值及附件；聊天回答可直接用 {{表名.行键.列名}}、{{table:表名}} 或 {{chart:文件名}}。完整内容用 get_artifact，参数更新用 source_run_id+params。

name: cancel_analysis
description: Cancel an isolated analysis task belonging to this project.

name: get_artifact
description: Read an attachment. rows={start,end} selects zero-based, end-exclusive CSV records, JSON items or text lines.

name: render_answer
description: Host-only formatter shared with report.md. Not a model tool.

name: rematerialize_documents
description: Host maintenance only. Rebuild facts from saved LangExtract mappings with zero model calls; preserves extraction ownership. Never expose as an Agent task.

name: get_research_model_schema
description: 读取当前模型 schema 及合成示例；0.10=10%，示例不是公司数据。

name: evaluate_research_model
description: Host calculator only. Evaluate a Decimal financial model with all explicit assumptions; no LLM and no data inference.

name: resolve_model_inputs
description: Host-only record binding, invoked by run_financial_model; exact project-scoped values and sources.

name: apply_model_overrides
description: Host only. Resolve exact numeric +/* operators with the same semantics as analysis params.

name: compare_research_models
description: Host calculator; compare immutable model inputs and optionally perform an ordered DCF decomposition.

name: deliver_research_models
description: Host only, not exposed to the model. Publish the input/result/difference tables and the calculator bundle of saved model versions; no sandbox run and no model call.

name: get_research_document_version
description: Host dependency check: current original-file and normalized-fact content version in one read snapshot.

name: execute_authorized_database_operation
description: Host only, not exposed to the model. UI authorization is verified by Node.

name: delete_library_document
description: Host only: direct user confirmation in attachment dashboard, never an agent tool.

name: get_attachment_flows
description: Host only: conversation-owned immutable processing results.

name: record_attachment_read
description: Host only: record a conversation's first use of existing evidence.

name: get_cleaning_batch
description: Read the next structural batch's complete numbered rows, headings and page context. Follow the Cleaner guide returned by process_documents; full geometry and surrounding pages remain available via source tools.

name: get_cleaning_progress
description: Host continuation: compact persisted table/page progress and next structural batch, without reloading the source or script guide.
